summary: Pixel notification bell that swings with a lagging clapper and pops its badge on new items; clicking it clears the badge in a spray of pixels.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Unread count, rounded to a whole number of at least 0. Changing it updates the count without ringing the bell.

events.name: notify
events.description: Fires on each new notification with the new unread count.

events.name: read
events.description: Fires when everything is marked as read, from a click on the bell or from `clearAll()`.

methods.description: Adds one unread notification, rings the bell and fires `notify`.
Marks everything as read and fires `read`. Does nothing when the count is already zero.

accessibility: The bell is a native button whose `aria-label` includes the count ("Notifications, 2 unread. Mark all as read" or "Notifications, all caught up").
The "N unread" / "All caught up" text is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
motion: With reduced motion, the bell and clapper do not swing and the clearing sparks are skipped; the sound waves and badge pop still play.
notes: The badge count is drawn in the monospace font and shows `9+` above nine. The bell canvas is a fixed 180 by 116px.

data.note: Pass the unread count as `count` and call `notify()` or `clearAll()`. Without it the bell starts at 2 unread.
